content: Definition of API function Rte_Stop Service Name Rte_Stop Syntax Std_ReturnType Rte_Stop ( void ) Service ID [hex] 0x71 Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Non Reentrant Parameters (in) None Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Std_ReturnType RTE_E_OK : No error occurred. RTE_E_LIMIT : A resource could not be released. Description Rte_Stop is used to finalize the RTE on the core it is called. This service releases all system and communication resources allocated by the RTE on that core. Available via Rte.h
